target.title: fix(macos): defer cookie import banner until inline browser opens
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where macOS app users could see the browser cookie-import banner while the embedded dashboard was still showing its Gateway connection or authentication screen. The automatic offer previously ran after app launch and every Gateway connection, before the inline browser was used.

## Why This Change Was Made

The first automatic cookie-import offer is now armed only when the inline browser sidebar opens. If that open happens before onboarding or while using a remote Gateway, the request stays pending and runs when an open sidebar first becomes eligible for Local mode. Later sidebar opens do not request it again after the first eligible local attempt. Settings -> General -> Browser login -> Import remains the explicit re-offer path.

This is the narrow timing follow-up to the inline banner introduced in #104591. AI-assisted; reviewed with the repository autoreview helper.

## User Impact

The Gateway connection/authentication screen stays clear. Eligible local-Gateway users see the cookie-import offer when it becomes relevant: during the first eligible inline-browser session.

## Evidence

- Added macOS regressions proving dashboard show and unarmed browser updates do not request the offer; an armed remote/pre-onboarding open stays pending; the first eligible Local-mode update requests it once; and later opens do not request it again.
- `./scripts/format-swift.sh` - clean.
- `./scripts/lint-swift.sh` - 0 violations.
- Blacksmith Testbox through Crabbox `tbx_01kxdd0wnvn87yr581p5bjhh2z`: `corepack pnpm check:changed` - passed 5 routed Vitest shards and all changed-file gates.
- Same Testbox: `corepack pnpm check:docs` - 0 Markdown errors, 0 broken links, docs map current.
- Blacksmith Testbox through Crabbox `tbx_01kxdh3d9g5xhbj24w1t5tcmjx`: `native:i18n:check`, `android:i18n:check`, and `apple:i18n:check` - passed for the eligibility regression (4,320 source entries).
- Testbox Actions run: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29239383423
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode uncommitted --engine codex --stream-engine-output ...` - clean, no accepted/actionable findings.

Visual recording is not attached because this native timing change requires a signed macOS app profile; the PR's macOS Swift lane builds and runs the exact regression on a macOS runner.
